preconditions.description: The number of levels in the tree is between 1 and 7000, inclusive.
The number of operations is between 1 and 7000, inclusive.
The level for the first type operation is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The range for the first type operation is within the number of vertices on level t.
The value to be added to sets is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.
The level for the second type operation is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The position for the second type operation is between 1 and the number of vertices on level t, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line_i in {0, 1} for output_line_i in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains either 0 or 1.
